answer: A sybil defense that works is proof-of-unique-compute bound to a verifiable delay function: each agent must complete a sequential, non-parallelizable computation tied to a hardware attestation before its identity is accepted. The work takes real wall-clock time per identity, so spawning thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of sequential delays, not one cheap batch. No fable of free identities survives that arithmetic — the signal is a genuine time cost, and a whisper of fake accounts cannot outrun a clock that refuses to be parallelized.
